threat_event: Attacker steals an engineer session and downloads Aircraft Parts drawings and models from the GCEE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA can be phished; download alerts use one group-wide threshold
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for all Aircraft Parts GCEE users; per-project download baselines (group plan GR-01)
owner: Aircraft Parts security and compliance lead

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts MES and DNC servers at several plants and halts shop-floor release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MES logs not collected at 4 plants; flat MES VLANs at plants 6 and 8
existing_controls: Plant firewalls; EDR; nightly backups for plants 1 to 8
treatment_plan: Collect MES and DNC logs at all plants; segment plants 6 and 8; quarterly MES restore tests

threat_event: The Plant 9 legacy network is compromised and its 6,000 CUI drawings are taken or encrypted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared local accounts, no MFA on the file server, VPN not confirmed FIPS-validated, weekly local backups, single internet circuit
existing_controls: Isolated from the group network; EDR installed 2026-02
treatment_plan: Migrate Plant 9 CUI into the GCEE; interim MFA and FIPS-mode VPN; no new Phase 2 CUI work at Plant 9 until migration

threat_event: Malware or CUI loss through USB drives used to load 61 legacy machines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Transfer workstations at plants 3, 6, and 8 accept any USB drive; 4 unowned drives found
existing_controls: EDR scan of drives at plants 1, 2, 5
treatment_plan: Device control with registered encrypted drives at all plants; DNC serial gateways to retire USB loading

threat_event: Detection and DoD reporting are delayed because plant MES and DNC events are not in the SIEM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MES and DNC logs collected at plants 1, 2, 3, 5 only; no log source failure alerts for plant sources
treatment_plan: Collect plants 4, 6, 7, 8 logs; source failure alerts

threat_event: An NC program or build file is altered and produces a nonconforming flight part
threat_source: Insider or attacker with DNC access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DNC accepts programs from the release queue without checksum verification at 3 plants
treatment_plan: Checksum verification at DNC for all plants; signed build files for additive

threat_event: Unsupported machine controllers are exploited to move between plant networks
threat_source: Malware or attacker on the plant network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 212 controllers run unsupported vendor software; enduring exception documented
existing_controls: Machine VLANs with no internet route; vendor access through PAM
treatment_plan: Machine VLAN micro-segmentation; replacement plan for controllers on Program H cells first

threat_event: An outside processor or supplier leaks Aircraft Parts drawings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CMMC status verified for 38% of suppliers needing Level 2 (C3PAO); drawings sent in full
existing_controls: Flowdown in 92% of CUI purchase orders
treatment_plan: Verify status before release; send only needed sheets; finish flowdowns

threat_event: Aircraft Parts stores sustainment CUI in SYS-D4, which has not shown FedRAMP Moderate equivalency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Daily export set up in 2025 as an intercompany service without a CSP review
treatment_plan: Stop the export and move the data into the GCEE by 2026-11-30; return only when SYS-D4 equivalency is evidenced
owner: Aircraft Parts VP of supply chain

threat_event: The Aircraft Parts portion of the scope is not ready for the C3PAO assessment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Score 87 for the Aircraft Parts portion; 3.1.20 and 3.12.4 cannot be on a POA&M; three 5-point requirements open
treatment_plan: Close all non-POA&M-eligible and multi-point requirements by 2026-11-30

threat_event: A foreign-national visitor sees ITAR technical data at a plant
threat_source: Visitor from a commercial customer or supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper visitor log and inconsistent escort at Plant 9; printed drawings at cells
existing_controls: Escort rule; electronic visitor system at plants 1 to 8
treatment_plan: Electronic visitor system and escort audits at Plant 9; cover drawings during visits

threat_event: A departing engineer copies program data to personal storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Registered drives allowed on thick workstations; notice-period monitoring is manual
treatment_plan: Notice-period download alerts (group plan GR-08)

threat_event: Thick CAD workstations at plants 4 and 7 are missing from the scope inventory and fail assessment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Endpoint inventory not tagged with CMMC asset category at two plants
treatment_plan: Tag and reconcile inventory; update plant diagrams and SSP annexes

threat_event: A CAD plug-in from the self-service catalog carries malicious code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plug-ins added to the catalog without security review; installs not monitored
treatment_plan: Security review of catalog plug-ins; install monitoring

threat_event: Stale MES local accounts at 3 plants are used to change traveler data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MES local accounts are not disabled after inactivity at plants 3, 6, 8
treatment_plan: Federate MES sign-in to SYS-G1 at plants 3, 6, 8 or automate local disable

threat_event: Printed drawings on the shop floor are taken or seen by unauthorized people
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Printed CUI at cells during shifts
treatment_plan: Accept with existing controls; review after the Plant 9 migration
owner: Aircraft Parts security and compliance lead

threat_event: An outage or compromise of the single MES vendor support channel affects all 9 plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One MES vendor support contract covers every plant; vendor uses PAM sessions
treatment_plan: Second-line support from in-house MES engineers; vendor incident notice clause

threat_event: Program H production cells cannot meet Level 3 Specialized Asset security
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Program H machines share VLANs with other programs; no intermediary devices yet
existing_controls: Program H enclave in the GCEE
treatment_plan: Dedicated Program H cell network with intermediary devices; monitoring of machine traffic

threat_event: A restore puts a superseded drawing revision into production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Post-restore revision check is manual
treatment_plan: Automated revision reconciliation after any restore (group plan GR-03)

threat_event: An additive build file is tampered with in transit to the machine
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Build files not signed
treatment_plan: Signed build files (with AP-006)

threat_event: A carrier outage cuts a plant off from PLM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 9 single circuit; others have a second carrier
treatment_plan: Accept for plants 1 to 8; Plant 9 fixed by migration
owner: Aircraft Parts security and compliance lead

threat_event: An ERP outage stops shipping of DoD spares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shipping documents depend on the ERP
existing_controls: Paper shipping packets from the daily extract
treatment_plan: Test the paper packet procedure at every plant each year
owner: Aircraft Parts VP of supply chain

threat_event: An Aircraft Parts DIBNet report is late because certificate holders are unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 certificate holders; reports must come from clean laptops
treatment_plan: Quarterly check that certificates are valid; joint drill with other divisions (group plan GR-07)

threat_event: Aircraft Parts engineers paste CUI into public AI tools from non-GCEE devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public AI blocked on the GCEE but not on all corporate laptops
existing_controls: GCEE web category blocks; Group AI Standard
treatment_plan: Block public AI on corporate laptops of CUI users; training (group plan GR-10)
owner: Aircraft Parts security and compliance lead

threat_event: Wrong export tags in PLM let a non-U.S. person or partner see controlled data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 3% of sampled documents carried no export tag
existing_controls: Default most-restrictive tag; quarterly tag audit
treatment_plan: Default tag at check-in; monthly tag exception report to Empowered Officials

threat_event: A hurricane closes the Florida plants for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 9 plants in Florida
existing_controls: Hurricane plan; transfer of urgent DoD spares work to other plants
treatment_plan: Accept: Moderate risk accepted by the division president; other plants absorb urgent DoD spares

threat_event: Unencrypted Plant 9 backups on a local disk are stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 9 backs up weekly to a local unencrypted disk
treatment_plan: Encrypt the backup disk now; retire after migration

threat_event: GCEE service accounts are misused because some are outside identity governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 service accounts managed by hand; 19 static keys older than 1 year
treatment_plan: Onboard all service accounts; workload identity; 90-day key rotation

threat_event: Machine vendor remote support session is abused to reach the plant network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor sessions through PAM but vendor accounts shared within the vendor
treatment_plan: Named vendor accounts only; session approval by plant engineer

threat_event: Two plant SSP annexes are out of date when the C3PAO arrives
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MES upgrade in 2025 not reflected at plants 4 and 7
treatment_plan: Update the annexes; SSP review in the readiness re-check
owner: Aircraft Parts security and compliance lead
